SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, D.TESTNAME, C.TESTCATEGORYDESC AS TESTCATEGORY FROM T_EMC_EMP_TEST A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD B ON A.TESTID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_CATEGORY C ON B.TESTCATEGORYID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST D ON B.TESTID = D.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
